```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

Round 3.14159 to the nearest whole number
```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
Ordering arguments
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times=7,x=5))
```
```{r}
my_variable <- 12
my_variable <- 10
print(my_variable)
```
Identifying types of variables
```{r}
x<- "hi there"
print(class(x))
```
Exercise - Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_ID_1<-"CX1"
cell_ID_2<-"CX2"

treated_1<-TRUE
treated_2<-FALSE

n_before_1<-5415
n_before_2<-8123

n_after_1<-1432
n_after_2<-7543
```

Exercise - Vectors
```{r}
cell_ID<-c(cell_ID_1,cell_ID_2)
treated<-c(treated_1,treated_2)
n_before<-c(n_before_1,n_before_2)
n_after<-c(n_after_1,n_after_2)
```

Exercise - Indexing
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_only_bird<-all_my_pets[4]
print(my_only_bird)
```
Using Tibble
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)
```

```{r}
fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = fruits,
  length = lengths,
  weight = weights
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```

Exercise - Creating a data frame
```{r}
radiation_experiment_data <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  num_cells_before = c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after = c(1432, 7543)
)

gt(radiation_experiment_data)
```
```{r}
radiation_experiment_data <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_ID,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = n_before,
  num_cells_after = n_after
)

gt(radiation_experiment_data)
```

weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
gt(weather)
